connectors.name: Grove (JST-GH 1.25mm)
connectors.orderNote: Labels printed as a horizontal line 'GND 3V3 IO44 IO43' beside the connector; position 1 at the right end, toward the USB Type-C side of the back view.

uncertain: Grove connector: the connector's pins are not visible in the photo (it sits inside the case slot); pin order is taken from the printed label line and its orientation relative to the physical pins is assumed.

'GPIO PINOUT (SI4732 Module Location)' header not transcribed: its pins are hidden in the case and the two printed label lines ('SDA IO16 GND 3V3 IO40' / 'SCL IO17 GND GND IO38 IO41') have 5 and 6 items, so the number of positions and the column grouping are open.
notes: LILYGO T-Embed SI4732 PINMAP: front and back photos of the enclosed device with peripheral-to-IO tables (LCD, ES7210 microphone, I2S speaker, encoder, RGB LED, TF card, SI4732). Only the Grove connector has a per-pin label line. Skipped: USB Type-C, SMA antenna, JST 1.25 speaker slot, TF slot, RESET, Power_On. The 'GPIO PINOUT' (SI4732 module location) labels are not transcribed (see uncertain).
